## Student Performance Predictor
Flags at-risk students by mid-term, while there's still time to help, with the reasons a teacher can act on.

Every Monday it reads current students (name, attendance, assignments, midterm, study_hours), predicts end-of-term scores with the linear model trained by `main.py` (paste YOUR coefficients from its output into MODEL), and emails form teachers the at-risk list with each student's weakest factor.

**Try it:** click *Test workflow* to run on the sample data. Then connect your credentials on the output nodes and activate.

Code and docs: github.com/Princewill106/student-performance-predictor
